planets.name: TOI-532 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-532 with a 2.33-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-532 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-532. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
